title: Enable custom agent task creation from the timeline
summary: Custom agents now support creating tasks directly from the timeline through an interface implementation, offering options to create a simple task or open the full test agent UI with draft preservation.
key_points: Implements IAgentManualTaskCreation interface for custom agents following the Sales Order Agent pattern
Adds option dialog defaulting to 'Create in Test Agent page' with alternative 'Create task' choice
Simple task dialog includes 'Open test agent' action visible only for custom agents
Maintains security checks for configuration permissions, inactive agents, and archived agents
Timeline file-upload task creation remains disabled
